description: Very expressive multilingual TTS (80+ languages). Type free-form [tags] anywhere in a segment's text to steer the delivery: [whisper], [laughing], [pause], [excited and fast]. Clones from a reference clip plus its transcript. Needs a 24 GB GPU. Research / non-commercial license.

settings.label: Reference transcript
settings.description: The exact words spoken in the reference clip. Required for cloning. Without a reference clip the model invents a different voice for every segment.
